title: Body styling
heading: Dress for your proportions, coloring and preferences.
intro: Start with an empty wardrobe. Get three complete menswear outfits with reasons for the fit, fabrics and color combinations.
profileIntro: Use a soft tape without pulling it tight. Required measurements are marked *; units are cm and kg.
generatingNote: Analyzing your saved measurements and planning three complete outfits. You can stay on this page; your previous recommendations remain available.
aiOffTitle: No AI connected: starter looks from fixed rules
aiOff: Looks are put together from fixed styling rules and still respect the season, occasion and your avoidances. Configure and enable a text model for tailored explanations.
statusError: Could not check the AI configuration. Try again.
schematicNote: Local schematics show colors, silhouette and stylized texture. They do not simulate try-on, actual fabric feel or brand sizing.
historyEmpty: Your first recommendation will appear here. No clothing uploads are needed.
snapshot: This report uses the measurements saved when it was generated.
emptyIntro: Fill in your height, chest, waist and hips, choose what you want to emphasize, then generate your first three looks.
formInvalid: Please complete the four required measurements with positive numbers.
inseamInvalid: Inseam must be shorter than height.
goalRequired: Choose at least one styling goal.

error.ai_unavailable: The text AI service is not enabled or configured yet. Save your measurements first, then check again after setup.
error.invalid_measurements: Complete valid height, chest, waist and hips measurements first. Inseam must be shorter than height.
error.invalid_ai_response: The model could not produce three complete, consistent looks. Your measurements are saved; please try again.
error.ai_timeout: The model took too long. Your measurements are saved; please try again.
error.ai_failed: The model service could not complete the request. Check its connection or try again.
error.load: Could not load this recommendation. It may not exist or belong to this account.
error.history: Could not load your recommendation history.
error.save: Could not save measurements. Please try again.
error.generic: Could not complete this request. Please try again.
error.body_measurements_conflict: Your measurements or styling preferences changed elsewhere. Load the latest data before saving or generating; the saved data has not been overwritten.
error.delete: Could not delete the report. Please try again.
error.queue_failed: The background job service is unavailable. Please try again later.
error.job_lost: The generation job was interrupted. Please try again.
error.report_not_ready: You can rate the looks once the report is finished.

personal.title: Personal color, fabrics and fit
personal.intro: All optional. Leave uncertain details blank; only your self-reported information is used.
personal.skinHelp: Look in natural daylight without makeup. Unsure of undertone? Wrist veins that look blue-purple suggest cool, green suggests warm; silver flattering you suggests cool, gold suggests warm.
personal.colorHelp: Preferred colors guide choices. Avoided colors are excluded from outfits. Selecting a family moves it out of the opposite group.
personal.fabricHelp: Use your past wearing experience. Avoided fibers and common blends containing them are excluded; check actual labels and try garments on.

feedback.title: Was this outfit useful?
feedback.intro: Feedback informs future generations without changing this report. Click again to clear.
feedback.error: Could not save feedback. Please try again.

measurementHelp: Enter body measurements, not flat garment dimensions. Measure body inseam from crotch to floor. Stand naturally with the tape snug, not tight; use the same waist position each time. Shoulder width and thigh are optional.
legacyReport: This report predates the color and fabric upgrade. Add preferences and generate again for the new analysis; this record stays unchanged.
personalSection: Personal colors, fabrics and fit concerns
pendingTitle: Creating your three looks in the background
pendingNote: This usually takes a minute or two. You can leave this page; the menu will show a dot when it is ready, and your notification channels will be told too.
failedTitle: This report could not be generated
retry: Try again with the same settings

today.title: Today's look
today.basis: Built from {season} rules and your body profile, without AI.
today.basisNoBody: Built from {season} rules; add your measurements for a closer fit.
today.explainFailed: The AI could not explain this look right now.
today.addClothes: Upload a few clothes you wear often to get looks from your own wardrobe
today.error: Today's look could not be loaded.

wardrobe.title: Compared with your wardrobe
wardrobe.empty: Your wardrobe is empty; add clothes to see which pieces you already own.
wardrobe.complete: Your wardrobe already covers every piece in these looks.
wardrobe.suggestTitle: Buy these first (your wardrobe makes {combinations} outfits now)
wardrobe.gain: adds {count} outfits with what you own
wardrobe.noGain: add a top, bottom and shoes first to count new outfits

packing.title: Trip packing list
packing.intro: From the destination's weather, each day's occasion and your body rules, the fewest pieces to pack and how to wear them each day.
packing.cityPlaceholder: Leave empty to use your saved location
packing.occasionsHelp: Several occasions rotate by day, e.g. work then formal then work.
packing.error: Could not make the list. Check the dates and try again.
packing.unknownCity: That city could not be found; try another spelling.
packing.noForecast: Beyond the forecast or without a location, so planned by calendar season.

styleExplore.title: Style explorer
styleExplore.subtitle: Japanese menswear has many branches. Go with your gut and find yours.
styleExplore.entryHint: Not sure what your style is? Take the quiz
styleExplore.intro: You will see a set of Japanese-style outfits. Don't overthink it: pick Like, Neutral or Dislike on first impression.
styleExplore.howRoundOne: Round one: one look from each Japanese sub-style, about 11 in all.
styleExplore.howRoundTwo: Round two: two more looks from each of your three favourite directions.
styleExplore.howResult: Then you get your main style, a starter checklist checked against your wardrobe, and search terms to explore further.
styleExplore.unsure: Nothing clicked this time; these two are the easiest places for a beginner to start
styleExplore.likedColors: The looks you liked often used: {colors}

bodyNote.solid: For reference: Japanese style guides find relaxed silhouettes such as workwear, yamakei, City Boy and Amekaji the most forgiving. What you like comes first.
bodyNote.tall_slim: For reference: a tall, slim frame carries clean or long styles such as kireime, mode and Ivy especially well. What you like comes first.

styleExplore.saveHint: Once saved, today's outfit, body styling reports and the assistant follow this direction. You can retake the quiz any time.
styleExplore.report: Create a report in this style
styleExplore.ask: Ask the assistant how to start
styleExplore.askPrompt: My style quiz result is "{style}". I'm new to dressing well; how should I start and what should I buy first?
styleExplore.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

lifestyle.title: Your week
lifestyle.hint: Tell us what work asks for and your budget; weekdays and weekends are planned separately and brands start from your price range.
lifestyle.planSwitch: Wear {weekday} on workdays and {weekend} at the weekend. Workday outfits and work reports follow {weekday}.
lifestyle.planSame: {style} works for both the office and the weekend.

silhouetteHint.I: Top and trousers are about the same width; a clean, straight line.
silhouetteHint.A: A fitted or short top over wide trousers; the weight sits low.
silhouetteHint.Y: A loose or long top over narrower trousers; the weight sits high.
silhouetteHint.H: Loose top and wide trousers; anchor one point with a bare ankle, rolled cuffs or a tuck.

technique.tonal_leg: Trousers and shoes in one tone

band.hot: Above 26°C: one breathable layer, no jacket.
band.warm: 21–25°C: mostly one layer, a light shirt to hand.
band.mild: 16–20°C: long sleeves or a light jacket; add a layer morning and evening.
band.cool: 11–15°C: a jacket over one inner layer.
band.cold: 6–10°C: a warm jacket or fleece over knitwear.
band.freezing: Below 5°C: a coat or down jacket; keep the neck warm.

sizes.label: Suggested flat measurements (compare with the size chart)
sizes.missing: Add your {fields} to see more measurements.
